budget_definition: Scale actual v1 depth-finetune policies: depth.Probe and fine_tune replace each head budget with 2944. Native LM pretraining budgets (64,256,736,1472) are not the evaluated baseline. All nonbudget policy fields and parameters remain unchanged.
protocol: All variants independently initialize from identical pretrained v1 weights; seed 0, new 5-token embedding and binary head, 30000 updates, B64 epoch permutation, AdamW lr 1e-4 wd 1e-4, clip 1, validation every 500, latest best-validation checkpoint selected; checkpoint every 32. Same ladder pools and EOS BCE as depth.py. Sequential variants under one parent and broker on cards 3/4 only.
telemetry: Per evaluation batch, block and head: final live occupancy, R-CAP event/refusal fraction and conditional refusal per append request, gate mean. Occupancy is final native live slots, not inaccurate cumulative event reconstruction.
verdict: Both thresholds passing supports budget-bound generalization within measured range; either miss falsifies the registered conjunction. Infrastructure failure remains incomplete, not a scientific miss. No 9x conclusion.
x28e_caveat: Read phase_diagram.json: B0x16 final evaluation is infrastructure-censored there, so user-supplied 0.95 at 9x is motivation, not independently verified by that receipt.
